formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x1 = (0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))); have x2 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x2 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x2.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x4 ∈ x2 | x1 (x4 - x3) = Bool.true}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ); have x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x4 ∈ x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x5 ∈ x3, x1 (x5 - x4) = Bool.false); have x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (∀ (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x1 (x5 - x6) = Bool.true → x4.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 = x5)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 = x6)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x5 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x2 x5 → x4.eval (x3 x5) = Bool.false; ∀ (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x5 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x5 → x4 x5 → x5.size < (64 : ℕ) → (∀ (x10 x11 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x10).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x11).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x5 x10 x11 → ∃ (x15 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x2 x15 ∧ (x5.wires (x3 x15)).getD ((26 : ℕ) + x10) Bool.false = Bool.true) → (∃ (x11 : ℕ) (x12 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x11).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x12).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x5 x11 x12) → ∃ (x12 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x12 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x12 ∧ x4 x12 ∧ x12.size < x5.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3 (line l = {l, l+1, l+3, l+9} mod 13; points then lines as 26 inputs). A fan-in-two AND/OR list reading earlier wires is good if it is true at every incident point-line input and false at every quadrangle input (4 points, at most 2 on any line, exactly the lines missing them on). If a good list has fewer than 64 gates, some AND gate inside another AND gate's cone, and every such inner AND gate true at some quadrangle input, then some good list has fewer gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Part 1 of 2 of a proof of: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input
